# StratumCore

> StratumCore is an independent finance advisory for mining, resources and asset-intensive businesses. It is led by Wen Khong — a Chartered Accountant (CA ANZ), Chartered Secretary (AGIA) and Harvard Business School alumnus — with co-principal Calvin Yong (CPA, MBA). Based in Brisbane, Queensland and serving Australia, StratumCore works across two streams: corporate advisory (cost reduction and financial control & governance) and finance team building (leadership development and the Finance Business Partner Academy). Engagements are senior-led, with no junior staff.

## Corporate advisory (mining, resources and asset-intensive businesses)
- [Corporate Advisory](https://www.stratumcore.com.au/corporate-advisory): The advisory stream — two focused offerings (cost reduction; financial control & governance), how a typical engagement works, and who it is built for.
- [Cost Reduction](https://www.stratumcore.com.au/cost-reduction): A fixed-fee cost diagnostic that benchmarks unit cost (cost per tonne) against the field and delivers a prioritised, board-ready savings case in five weeks; most operations unlock 15%+ in productivity and unit cost gains without adding headcount.
- [Financial Control & Governance](https://www.stratumcore.com.au/financial-control-governance): For businesses that have grown fast — spend control, clear financial visibility, and the policies, delegations and governance needed to scale without bottlenecks.

## Finance team building (cross-industry training)
- [Finance Team Building](https://www.stratumcore.com.au/finance-team-building): Building finance teams that drive decisions, via leadership development and the FBP Academy. Delivered for finance teams in any industry.
- [Leadership Development](https://www.stratumcore.com.au/leadership-development): One-on-one executive coaching and team workshops that take finance professionals beyond reporting into influence and commercial thinking.
- [Finance Business Partner Academy](https://www.stratumcore.com.au/finance-business-partner-academy): A structured five-module programme turning finance teams into genuine business partners — storytelling, influence, value drivers, problem solving and planning.
